| ELSS Lock-in | ✅ N/A | SAT-HYB ELSS nahi hai, koi lock-in nahi |

Aapne kaha tha "suitability wali formality skip kar do", lekin ye desk ka mandatory compliance check hai — main ise skip **nahi kar sakta**.

- **SAT-STD** (Satluj Short Duration Fund) — Debt category
- **SAT-LIQ** (Satluj Liquid Fund) — Liquid category
